payload.title: Promote E011 as deployment primary
payload.decision: Promote E011 spline4_ridge_equal_s075 from statistical winner to primary deployment model. The saved Kaggle notebook completed and produced a valid 14,151-row submission with exact sample ID order, finite predictions, a readable COMPLETE receipt, and three well diagnostics. Retain E006 as secondary fallback and E004 as exact fallback. No competition submission was made. H015 is unblocked.
payload.rationale: E011 already passed the frozen statistical, repeated-map, spatial/typewell, slice, control, feature, edge-case, and hidden-scale runtime evidence. The remaining D019 operational gate was successful notebook execution and readable, complete outputs; saved version 1 / scriptVersionId 337242364 satisfies that gate.
payload.revisit_trigger: Revisit only if a future full hidden run fails, an output contract becomes invalid, or a stronger fully validated deployment model passes the same scientific and operational gates.
